Migrated existing fixtures use the explicit operator grant/activation helper; no weakened auth-negative assertions or direct grant-table fixture bypass were found in the reviewed diffs.
Native failed 16/19 and 18/19 browser runs, early lock attempt, superseded 19-case run, and unredirected short focused failures are retained/candidly disclosed in acceptance evidence.
limitations: Focused independent run covers the requested five cases, not a repeat of the 154-test standard suite or all 32 product/19 browser cases.
Oracle and scanner were not run; separate Oracle status remains BLOCKED and scanner availability is independent of this product verdict.
